blocks.html: Electrically powered exit signs shall be listed and labeled in accordance with UL 924, except that letters of exit signs shall be red. Exit signs shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and Chapter 27 of this code. Exit signs shall be illuminated at all times. The letters of exit signs shall be red.
